page.content:
Wukong's war on the Jade Emperor before the five-century imprisonment.

How Revolt against Heaven connects

  • Character: Sun Wukong — Wukong leads the war that earns him the Great Sage title and the fall.
  • Location: Heaven — The revolt is fought through the halls of Heaven.
  • Item: Peaches of immortality — Theft of the peaches helps turn Wukong's service into open revolt.
  • Character: Nezha — Nezha is sent among the heavenly champions against Wukong.

What is Revolt against Heaven?

The revolt against Heaven fills the novel's first seven chapters: the Sage's title, the wrecked peach banquet, the failure of the heavenly armies, and the Buddha's wager.

Key threads lead to Sun Wukong, Heaven, Peaches of immortality and Nezha.
